summary: Re-verification smoke test for EDS PIXEL after iteration_1. Backend: admin + tecnico login OK, /api/auth/me returns correct role, /api/dashboard/stats returns full KPI payload (counts, denaro_fermo, target_min/max, daily_fixed_cost, today totals), /api/public/settings returns business_name unauthenticated, role gating confirmed (tecnico DELETE /api/tickets/* -> 403), POST /api/tickets creates ticket with code EDS-261002-7EFE and auto 4-digit PIN, GET /api/public/track/{code} strips pin/pattern/imei. Frontend: admin login succeeds, dashboard renders all KPIs (kpi-in-registro, kpi-in-lavorazione, kpi-pronto, kpi-consegnato, kpi-denaro-fermo, piano-riscatto, business-tip), admin accesses /settings, tecnico dashboard loads without 'Impostazioni' in sidebar (role gating OK). Public tracking page at /track/EDS-* renders track-card unauthenticated.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin + tecnico return JWT (227/228 chars)
GET /api/auth/me returns role=admin for admin token
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns counts, denaro_fermo, target_min/max, daily_fixed_cost, today_sales_total, today_repairs_total, today_total
GET /api/public/settings unauth returns business_name='EDS PIXEL di Emilio De Leo'
POST /api/tickets creates ticket with code=EDS-261002-7EFE, pin=8956 (4-digit auto), status=in_registro
GET /api/public/track/{code} unauth returns ticket WITHOUT pin/imei fields
Dashboard KPIs render: kpi-denaro-fermo, piano-riscatto, business-tip all present
nav-settings data-testid present for admin, admin can navigate to /settings
Tecnico login -> /dashboard; sidebar does NOT show 'Impostazioni' entry (role-based UI gating confirmed via screenshot)
Public /track/{code} renders track-card unauth; invalid code shows track-not-found (confirmed iter_1)
